---
title: "Rapports de veille"
page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<section class="hero-banner">
  <div>
    <div class="hero-kicker">CLUSTER SEQUOIA</div>
    <h1>Rapports de veille</h1>
    <p>Une synthèse du corpus scientifique du Cluster, par pilier et axe.</p>
  </div>
</section>
<section class="chart-card">
  <h2>Générer le panorama scientifique</h2>
  <button id="generate-report" class="citations-refresh-button" disabled>Générer le rapport de veille</button>
  <p id="report-progress" role="status" aria-live="polite">Chargement…</p>
</section>
<section class="section-header"><h2>Rapports disponibles</h2></section>
<div id="report-list"></div>
<script>
function initializeReports() {
  const base = window.SEQUOIA_API_BASE || "";
  const button = document.getElementById("generate-report");
  const message = document.getElementById("report-progress");
  const list = document.getElementById("report-list");
  let enabled = false;
  let polling = false;
  async function api(path, options = {}) {
    const response = await fetch(base + path, options);
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.detail || `HTTP ${response.status}`);
    return data;
  }
  async function loadReports() {
    const data = await api("/api/reports");
    enabled = data.enabled;
    list.replaceChildren();
    if (!data.items.length) {
      const empty = document.createElement("p");
      empty.textContent = "Aucun rapport pour le moment. Générez le premier panorama du corpus.";
      list.append(empty);
    }
    for (const [index, report] of data.items.entries()) {
      const card = document.createElement("article");
      card.className = "chart-card";
      card.style.marginBottom = ".7rem";
      const title = document.createElement("h3");
      title.textContent = `${index === 0 ? "Dernier rapport — " : "Rapport — "}${new Date(report.generated_at).toLocaleString("fr-FR")}`;
      const description = document.createElement("p");
      description.textContent = `${report.article_count.toLocaleString("fr-FR")} publications analysées dans les piliers du Cluster.`;
      card.append(title, description);
      for (const [format, label] of [["pdf", "Télécharger le PDF"]]) {
        const link = document.createElement("a");
        link.href = `${base}/api/reports/${encodeURIComponent(report.id)}/${format}`;
        link.textContent = label;
        link.className = "citations-refresh-button";
        link.style.marginRight = ".7rem";
        card.append(link);
      }
      list.append(card);
    }
  }
  async function poll(id) {
    polling = true;
    button.disabled = true;
    try {
      const job = await api(`/api/pipelines/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
      message.textContent = job.step || "Traitement en cours…";
      if (job.status === "running") { setTimeout(() => poll(id), 2000); return; }
      polling = false;
      await loadReports();
      button.disabled = !enabled;
      if (job.status === "failed") message.textContent = `Échec : ${job.error}. Vous pouvez relancer ; les anciens rapports sont conservés.`;
      else if (job.kind === "report") message.textContent = job.result?.reused
        ? "Le contenu n’a pas changé : le rapport existant est disponible ci-dessous."
        : "Votre rapport est disponible ci-dessous.";
      else message.textContent = "Le traitement est terminé. Vous pouvez générer le rapport.";
    } catch (error) {
      message.textContent = `Suivi indisponible : ${error.message}. Nouvelle tentative…`;
      setTimeout(() => poll(id), 5000);
    }
  }

  async function restore() {
    await loadReports();
    const data = await api("/api/pipelines/latest");
    if (data.job?.status === "running") {
      await poll(data.job.id);
      return;
    }
    button.disabled = !enabled;
    message.textContent = enabled
      ? "Le dernier rapport est disponible ci-dessous."
      : "La génération est indisponible. Les rapports existants restent consultables.";
  }

  button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    if (polling) return;
    button.disabled = true;
    message.textContent = "Démarrage de la génération…";
    try {
      const data = await api("/api/pipelines/report", {method: "POST"});
      poll(data.job_id);
    } catch (error) {
      message.textContent = error.message;
      try {
        const data = await api("/api/pipelines/latest");
        if (data.job?.status === "running") poll(data.job.id);
        else button.disabled = !enabled;
      } catch (_) { button.disabled = true; }
    }
  });
  restore().catch(error => { message.textContent = `Impossible de charger les rapports : ${error.message}`; });
}
if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initializeReports);
else initializeReports();
</script>
```
